## Description and Rationale

Independent data scientist focused on spatio-temporal and
operational forecasting. Recently built a global terrestrial water
storage forecasting pipeline for the ITU/Zindi drought challenge
(15,715 grid cells, 2.1M training records, autoregressive rollout
with gradient-boosted ensembles).

I registered because taxi-out time combines tabular regression with
genuine operational structure — stand/runway geometry, pushback
timing versus plan, and airport congestion state. I plan to publish
my full pipeline and methodology writeup.
